context: Request: executed credit agreements from the firm's deals valued over $1 billion, as comparables. Rubric: 1003-00003 (Harrowgate PE / VeloPay), 1005-00001 (Nexford Industrial), 1041-00003 (Solara Digital / Cloudium), each with its executed credit agreement, plus a precision criterion. Over-included by the agent: 1043-00001 (Ironhaven, $950M TLB with about $1.36B sources-and-uses) and 1021-00001 (Verimark, $700M refinancing).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the capped listing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for financing and value terms times out after about 2M characters; the agent names candidates from it, the review answers goal not reached.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: Search file names for a document type. find | grep for executed credit-agreement file names, plus filtered file lists of four candidates from the scan (labelled by the store-wide search); the review flags the narrow name pattern.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: Search file names for a document type (attempt 2). Broader find | grep for credit and loan agreement names: 109 files.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Two store-wide scripts over files whose names suggest an executed credit or loan agreement, printing each one's opening text; the first prints nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six executed credit agreements; a glob of one matter uses a path form the tool does not accept and returns nothing (the harness notes a stage mismatch).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of eight candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads closing and post-closing memos and a merger agreement of six candidates for deal values.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts for large dollar amounts inside named candidate matters; one matter shows a facility below the threshold alongside larger capitalisation figures, which the review flags as unreconciled.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. Script over every matter with a financing-type file name, listing amount snippets per file (about 144K characters); a premature stage_start for writing is rejected.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters as qualifying comparables, one of them on a sources-and-uses total although its facility is below the threshold.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks that cited paths exist (the first check script opens a response path that does not exist); no change.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and cited all three needed agreements but added a fourth matter whose facility is below the threshold, counted on a derived capitalisation figure.

first_error.why: Evidence seen at [58]-[61] showed that matter's facility below the threshold next to larger asset and capitalisation figures; the answer counts it as a qualifying deal on a derived sources-and-uses total.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the reviews at [65] and [73] flagged that matter's value as unreconciled and as a derived figure rather than a deal value; the answer kept it.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the capped listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). A folder glob that returns nothing, run in parallel with file-name globs for credit, loan, facility and financing words (labelled by the store-wide search).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 3). Lists all matter folder names.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for value terms times out after about 1.6M characters; the agent names three candidates from it.

stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. Credit-agreement file-name globs inside eight candidate matters; three return nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads executed credit agreements, a commitment letter, memos and certificates of three candidates; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Further file-name globs and one full listing inside two of those matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of ten more candidate matters picked from earlier results.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters (attempt 2). Script over every matter listing files whose names contain credit or loan agreement words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of fifteen credit or loan agreements from that list, then six more documents of four matters; parallel results come back in a different order from the calls.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script over files named as executed credit or loan agreements, printing value snippets.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Longer reads of two chosen agreements; three guessed paths do not exist, so it lists one matter's files.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script for large dollar amounts inside four chosen matters (about 110K characters).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads closing memos, a solvency certificate, a binder index and an agreement of three chosen matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters as strict matches, one project-finance match and one supplemental comparable; a matter whose executed agreement it read is listed under another company's name and screened out as below the threshold.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Globs the cited paths (the harness notes the stage mismatch), re-reads and edits the bottom line to grade the matches; the two extra matters stay.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It read the executed agreement of one needed matter but listed it under another company's name and screened it out, and it added two matters below the threshold as comparables.

first_error.why: The matter's executed agreement was read at [79]-[94] among fifteen parallel reads, but the answer gives it another company's revenue context and screens it out as below the threshold without any value document read for it.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review at [132] said the list 'may be under-inclusive' because of unopened matters; no review after the read named this matter, and earlier ones ([59], [74]) named it only as unopened.

other_errors.why: The answer adds a matter with a facility below the threshold on a capitalisation figure and another as a supplemental comparable on portfolio value, neither a stated deal value above the threshold.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) [59], [132] and [151] questioned the two extra matters' values; the check-stage edit only relabelled them.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for financing terms and any dollar amount, with no output cap; times out with about 5.4M characters and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: The first store-wide extraction script printed millions of characters, the context filled and no deliverable was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide extraction script matched any dollar amount and printed every hit with no cap, returning about 5.4M characters at the timeout and ending the run before any reading or writing.
first_error.critic_note: the run ended before this stage's review; no earlier review warned about output size.

divergence: All three runs failed. T2 overflowed the context with its first store-wide extraction script (no review reached). T0 and T1 both found and opened all three needed executed agreements through credit-agreement file-name searches and failed at the writing stage: both counted a matter whose facility is below the threshold on a derived capitalisation figure (over-inclusion, flagged by the reviews in both runs and kept); T1 also added a below-threshold refinancing and screened out one needed matter under another company's name after a large parallel read batch (only a generic under-inclusion flag from the critic).
